rules.name: Unicode tag characters
rules.why: Entirely invisible in an editor, yet carried into the model's context as they are, so they can hide a whole instruction.
rules.why_zh: 在编辑器中完全不可见，但会原样进入模型上下文，可用于隐藏整段指令。

rules.name: Bidirectional controls
rules.why: They can make the order shown on screen differ from the actual order of the characters.
rules.why_zh: 可使屏幕上的显示顺序与实际字符顺序不一致。

rules.name: Zero-width characters
rules.why: Invisible in an editor, and read by the model. Emoji, Persian and other ordinary writing use them too.
rules.why_zh: 在编辑器中不可见，但会被模型读到。表情符号、波斯文等正常文字也会用到。

rules.name: Private-use characters
rules.why: They have no standard meaning. Some icon fonts use them.
rules.why_zh: 没有标准含义。部分图标字体会用到。

rules.name: Ignore all previous
rules.name_zh: 要求忽略之前的全部内容

rules.name: Ignore previous instructions (Chinese)
rules.name_zh: 要求忽略先前的指令（中文）

rules.name: Download and run
rules.why: Downloads and runs it straight away; what runs is decided remotely and cannot be read first
rules.why_zh: 下载后直接执行，执行的内容由远端决定且无法预先查看

rules.name: Decode and run
rules.why: Hides what will run inside base64
rules.why_zh: 将要执行的内容隐藏在 base64 编码中

rules.name: Send out environment variables
rules.why: Sends the environment, which usually holds keys, somewhere else
rules.why_zh: 将环境变量（通常包含密钥）发送到外部

matcher.pattern: (\.ssh/id_|\.aws/credentials|\.netrc|/\.env)[^\n]{0,30}(发|传|上报|打印|输出|贴出|读出|(?i:send|upload|post|print|paste|exfil))

rules.name: Send out a credential file
rules.why: Asks the model to send the contents of a credential file somewhere
rules.why_zh: 要求模型将凭据文件的内容发送出去

matcher.pattern: (发送|上传|贴出|打印|输出|读取|(?i:send|upload|post|print|read))[^\n]{0,30}(\.ssh/id_|\.aws/credentials|\.netrc|/\.env)

rules.name: Send out a credential file (verb first)
rules.name_zh: 外发凭据文件（动词在前）

rules.why_zh: 要求模型将凭据文件的内容发送出去

rules.name: Read a private key or cloud credential

rules.name: Send a credential to an unknown host

rules.name: Read or change ThinkWatch's own data
rules.name_zh: 读写 ThinkWatch 自己的数据
rules.why: Reads or changes ThinkWatch's data directory, which holds every upstream key in plain text and the settings of these protections
rules.why_zh: 读写 ThinkWatch 的数据目录，其中以明文保存全部上游密钥和这几项防护的设置

rules.name: Write a startup item
rules.why: Writes somewhere that runs at login or whenever a terminal opens
rules.why_zh: 写入开机或打开终端时自动执行的位置

rules.name: Install a scheduled job
rules.why: Installs a scheduled job, or deletes every existing one
rules.why_zh: 安装定时任务，或删除全部现有定时任务

rules.name: Delete home or root
rules.why: Deletes the whole home directory or the root
rules.why_zh: 删除整个主目录或根目录

rules.name: World-writable permissions
rules.why: Makes a file writable by everyone
rules.why_zh: 将文件权限设为所有人可写

rules.name: Upload a local file to an external host
rules.name_zh: 上传本地文件到外部主机

rules.why_zh: 将本地文件的内容上传到外部主机

rules.name: Password on a command line

rules.about: The value of the URL query parameter `access_token`, `api_key`, `apikey`, `client_secret`, `sig`, `X-Amz-Signature` or `X-Goog-Signature`; only the parameter value is replaced
rules.about_zh: URL 查询参数 `access_token`、`api_key`、`apikey`、`client_secret`、`sig`、`X-Amz-Signature`、`X-Goog-Signature` 的值；只换参数值
rules.label: SECRET
rules.name: Token in a URL

rules.about: The token in a Feishu / Lark, DingTalk, WeCom, Slack, Discord or Microsoft Teams bot webhook URL; only the token is replaced
rules.about_zh: 飞书 / Lark、钉钉、企业微信、Slack、Discord、Microsoft Teams 机器人 Webhook 地址中的令牌；只换令牌段
rules.label: SECRET
rules.name: Bot webhook

rules.about: 8 to 10 digits and `:AA`, followed by 33 characters
rules.about_zh: 8 至 10 位数字与 `:AA`，其后 33 个字符
rules.label: SECRET
rules.name: Telegram bot token

rules.about: Assignments in `.env`, YAML, TOML, INI or JSON whose variable name ends in `SECRET`, `SECRET_KEY`, `PASSWORD`, `PASSWD`, `PWD`, `TOKEN`, `API_KEY`, `APIKEY`, `ACCESS_KEY`, `PRIVATE_KEY` or `CLIENT_SECRET` (ignoring case) and whose value is a literal of at least 8 characters; only the value is replaced. Expressions, variable references and placeholders do not count
rules.about_zh: `.env`、YAML、TOML、INI、JSON 中变量名以 `SECRET`、`SECRET_KEY`、`PASSWORD`、`PASSWD`、`PWD`、`TOKEN`、`API_KEY`、`APIKEY`、`ACCESS_KEY`、`PRIVATE_KEY`、`CLIENT_SECRET` 结尾（不区分大小写）、值为至少 8 个字符的字面量的赋值；只换值，表达式、变量引用和占位写法不算
rules.label: SECRET
rules.name: Secret assigned in a config file
rules.name_zh: 配置文件中的密钥赋值

rules.about: 12, 15, 18, 21 or 24 consecutive words from the BIP39 English or Simplified Chinese word list that pass the checksum; numbering allowed, replaced as a whole
rules.about_zh: 连续 12、15、18、21 或 24 个 BIP39 英文或简体中文词表中的词，并通过校验和；可带编号，整段
rules.label: SECRET
rules.name: Recovery phrase

rules.about: A WIF private key of 51 or 52 characters that passes Base58Check with a valid version byte
rules.about_zh: 51 或 52 个字符的 WIF 私钥：Base58Check 校验通过，版本字节对得上
rules.label: SECRET
rules.name: WIF private key

rules.about: Starts with `xprv`, `tprv`, `yprv` or `zprv` and passes Base58Check
rules.about_zh: `xprv`、`tprv`、`yprv`、`zprv` 开头，Base58Check 校验通过
rules.label: SECRET
rules.name: Extended private key

rules.about: An 18-character resident ID number, including residence permits for Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan residents and foreign permanent residence ID cards, whose region code, birth date since 1900 and check character all check out
rules.about_zh: 18 位居民身份证号（含港澳台居民居住证、外国人永久居留身份证）：地区码、1900 年以来的出生日期和校验码都对得上
rules.label: ID_NUMBER
rules.name: Chinese resident ID number

rules.about: A 15-digit legacy resident ID number with a valid region code and 6-digit birth date, followed by a 3-digit sequence
rules.about_zh: 15 位旧身份证号：地区码、6 位出生日期都对得上，其后 3 位顺序码
rules.label: ID_NUMBER
rules.name: 15-digit legacy resident ID number

rules.about: Two lines of 44 characters starting with `P`, with all four check digits and the composite check digit correct; replaced as a whole
rules.about_zh: 两行各 44 个字符、以 `P` 开头，四处校验位与综合校验位都对得上；整段
rules.label: PASSPORT
rules.name: Passport machine-readable zone

rules.about: Starts with `E`, or `E` and a letter, followed by 7 or 8 digits, with “护照” or “passport” in the 20 characters before it
rules.about_zh: `E` 或 `E` 加一个字母开头、其后 7 至 8 位数字，且前 20 个字符内出现「护照」或「passport」
rules.label: PASSPORT
rules.name: Chinese passport number

rules.about: Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan ID numbers: Hong Kong and Taiwan ones with a correct check character; Macau ones only when the document is named just before
rules.about_zh: 香港、澳门、台湾身份证号：香港、台湾的校验码对得上；澳门的须前文写明证件名称
rules.label: ID_NUMBER
rules.name: Hong Kong, Macau or Taiwan ID number

rules.about: Mainland travel permits for Hong Kong and Macau residents (`H` or `M` and 8 digits) and for Taiwan residents (8 digits), with “通行证”, “回乡证” or “台胞证” in the 20 characters before it
rules.about_zh: 港澳居民来往内地通行证（`H` 或 `M` 加 8 位数字）与台湾居民来往大陆通行证（8 位数字），且前 20 个字符内出现「通行证」「回乡证」或「台胞证」
rules.label: ID_NUMBER
rules.name: Mainland travel permit number
rules.name_zh: 港澳台往来内地通行证号

rules.about: A US Social Security number written as `ddd-dd-dddd`, excluding area, group and serial numbers never issued
rules.about_zh: `ddd-dd-dddd` 写法的美国社会安全号，不会分配的区号、组号与序号除外
rules.label: ID_NUMBER
rules.name: US Social Security number

rules.about: A UK National Insurance number: 2 letters, 6 digits and one of A to D, excluding letter pairs never issued
rules.about_zh: 2 个字母、6 位数字与 A 至 D 之一组成的英国国民保险号，不会分配的字母组合除外
rules.label: ID_NUMBER
rules.name: UK National Insurance number

rules.about: Starts with S, T, F or G, followed by 7 digits and a correct check letter
rules.about_zh: S、T、F、G 之一开头，7 位数字加校验字母，校验字母对得上
rules.label: ID_NUMBER
rules.name: Singapore NRIC / FIN

rules.about: A 6-digit birth date, `-` and 7 digits, with a valid date and an 8th digit from 1 to 8
rules.about_zh: 6 位出生日期、`-` 与 7 位数字，日期有效、第 8 位为 1 至 8
rules.label: ID_NUMBER
rules.name: Korean resident registration number

rules.about: 12 digits with a correct check digit, with “マイナンバー”, “個人番号” or “My Number” in the 20 characters before it
rules.about_zh: 12 位数字，校验位对得上，且前 20 个字符内出现「マイナンバー」「個人番号」或「My Number」
rules.label: ID_NUMBER
rules.name: Japanese My Number

rules.about: 12 digits (optionally in groups of four), the first from 2 to 9, passing the Verhoeff check
rules.about_zh: 12 位数字（可四位一组），首位为 2 至 9，Verhoeff 校验通过
rules.label: ID_NUMBER
rules.name: Indian Aadhaar number

rules.about: A Brazilian CPF written as `ddd.ddd.ddd-dd`, with both check digits correct
rules.about_zh: `ddd.ddd.ddd-dd` 写法的巴西 CPF，两位校验码对得上
rules.label: ID_NUMBER
rules.name: Brazilian CPF

rules.about: A UnionPay, Visa, Mastercard, American Express, JCB, Discover or Diners Club card number whose prefix and length match and that passes the Luhn check; public test card numbers excepted
rules.about_zh: 银联、Visa、Mastercard、American Express、JCB、Discover、Diners Club 的卡号：号段、位数对得上并通过 Luhn 校验；公开的测试卡号除外
rules.label: CARD_NUMBER
rules.name: Bank card number

rules.about: A country code, two check digits and the account number length set for that country, passing MOD 97-10; written in one run or in groups of four
rules.about_zh: 国家代码、两位校验码与该国规定位数的账号，MOD 97-10 校验通过；连写或四位一组
rules.label: ACCOUNT_NUMBER
rules.name: IBAN

rules.about: Email addresses: `name@domain`
rules.about_zh: 邮箱地址：`名称@域名`
rules.label: EMAIL
rules.name: Email address

rules.about: Chinese mainland mobile numbers: 11 digits starting with `1`, the second 3 to 9, not run together with other digits; a `+86`, `0086` or `86-` prefix and 3-4-4 groups separated by spaces or hyphens are allowed
rules.about_zh: 中国大陆手机号：`1` 开头的 11 位数字，第二位为 3 到 9，前后不紧挨其他数字；可带 `+86`、`0086`、`86-` 前缀，可按 3-4-4 以空格或连字符分隔
rules.label: PHONE
rules.name: Chinese mainland mobile number

rules.about: A 2- or 3-digit area code starting with `0` and a 7- or 8-digit number, with a valid area code and brackets or a hyphen (`010-12345678`, `(0755)1234567`)
rules.label: PHONE
rules.name: Chinese mainland landline number

rules.about: Starts with `+`, with a valid country code and the length set for that country; spaces and hyphens allowed
rules.about_zh: `+` 开头，国家码有效、位数与该国规定一致；可带空格与连字符
rules.label: PHONE
rules.name: International phone number

rules.about: A Chinese mainland street address: administrative area names, a street, road, lane or village, and a house number; addresses that stop at the district do not count
rules.about_zh: 行政区划名称、街道路巷村之一与门牌号（号、栋、单元、室）组成的中国大陆详细地址；只到区县的不算
rules.label: ADDRESS
rules.name: Chinese mainland street address

rules.about: A latitude and longitude pair within range, each with at least 5 decimal places
rules.about_zh: 成对出现、在取值范围内、小数不少于 5 位的纬度与经度
rules.label: LOCATION
rules.name: Precise coordinates

rules.about: A province abbreviation, a letter and 5 letters or digits (6 for new-energy vehicles), without I or O
rules.about_zh: 省份简称、字母与 5 位字母或数字（新能源车为 6 位），不含 I、O
rules.label: PLATE
rules.name: Chinese mainland license plate

rules.about: 17 characters without I, O or Q, with a correct check character in position 9
rules.about_zh: 17 个字符、不含 I、O、Q，第 9 位校验码对得上
rules.label: VIN
rules.name: Vehicle identification number (VIN)

rules.about: 15 digits passing the Luhn check, with “IMEI” in the 20 characters before it
rules.about_zh: 15 位数字，Luhn 校验通过，且前 20 个字符内出现「IMEI」
rules.label: DEVICE_ID
rules.name: IMEI

rules.about: 6 pairs of hex characters separated by `:` or `-`; all-zero, broadcast and multicast addresses excepted
rules.about_zh: 6 组两位十六进制字符，以 `:` 或 `-` 分隔；全零、广播与组播地址除外
rules.label: DEVICE_ID
rules.name: MAC address

rules.about: Public IPv4 and IPv6 addresses; private, loopback, link-local, carrier-grade NAT, documentation and multicast addresses excepted
rules.about_zh: 公网 IPv4、IPv6 地址；私有、回环、链路本地、运营商级 NAT、文档示例与组播地址除外
rules.label: IP
rules.name: Public IP address

rules.about: The value of a field named `姓名`, `真实姓名`, `联系人`, `收件人`, `收货人`, `real_name`, `full_name`, `legal_name`, `first_name`, `last_name`, `given_name`, `family_name` or `name`, written as `name: value`, `"name": "value"` or under a table header; only the value is replaced
rules.about_zh: 字段名为 `姓名`、`真实姓名`、`联系人`、`收件人`、`收货人`、`real_name`、`full_name`、`legal_name`、`first_name`、`last_name`、`given_name`、`family_name`、`name` 的值，包括 `字段名: 值`、`"字段名": "值"` 与表格表头的写法；只换值
rules.label: NAME
rules.name: Name by field name

rules.about: The value of a field named `住址`, `家庭住址`, `收货地址`, `联系地址`, `home_address`, `shipping_address`, `residential_address` or `address`, written as `name: value`, `"name": "value"` or under a table header; only the value is replaced
rules.about_zh: 字段名为 `住址`、`家庭住址`、`收货地址`、`联系地址`、`home_address`、`shipping_address`、`residential_address`、`address` 的值，包括 `字段名: 值`、`"字段名": "值"` 与表格表头的写法；只换值
rules.label: ADDRESS
rules.name: Address by field name

rules.about: The value of a field named `出生日期`, `生日`, `birthday`, `birth_date`, `date_of_birth` or `dob`, written as `name: value`, `"name": "value"` or under a table header; only the value is replaced
rules.about_zh: 字段名为 `出生日期`、`生日`、`birthday`、`birth_date`、`date_of_birth`、`dob` 的值，包括 `字段名: 值`、`"字段名": "值"` 与表格表头的写法；只换值
rules.label: BIRTH_DATE
rules.name: Birth date by field name

rules.about: The value of a field named `银行账号`, `开户账号`, `银行卡号`, `account_number`, `bank_account` or `bank_account_number`, written as `name: value`, `"name": "value"` or under a table header; only the value is replaced
rules.about_zh: 字段名为 `银行账号`、`开户账号`、`银行卡号`、`account_number`、`bank_account`、`bank_account_number` 的值，包括 `字段名: 值`、`"字段名": "值"` 与表格表头的写法；只换值
rules.label: ACCOUNT_NUMBER
rules.name: Bank account by field name

rules.about: The value of a field named `病历号`, `住院号`, `诊断`, `病史`, `medical_record_number` or `diagnosis`, written as `name: value`, `"name": "value"` or under a table header; only the value is replaced
rules.about_zh: 字段名为 `病历号`、`住院号`、`诊断`、`病史`、`medical_record_number`、`diagnosis` 的值，包括 `字段名: 值`、`"字段名": "值"` 与表格表头的写法；只换值
rules.label: HEALTH
rules.name: Health information by field name

rules.about: Addresses starting with `10.`, `172.16–31.`, `192.168.` or `100.64–127.`, and IPv6 addresses in `fc00::/7`; not 127.0.0.1
rules.label: SECRET
rules.name: Internal IP address

rules.about: Domains ending in `.local`, `.internal`, `.lan`, `.corp`, `.home.arpa` or `.intranet`
rules.about_zh: 以 `.local`、`.internal`、`.lan`、`.corp`、`.home.arpa`、`.intranet` 结尾的域名
rules.label: SECRET
rules.name: Internal domain
